nodes.label: Desktop Build GitHub Actions Workflow
nodes.rationale: Manual runs produce downloadable artifacts; pushing a v* tag also attaches installers to a GitHub Release. Each runner builds its OWN platform natively and jlinks its OWN bundled JRE into resources/jre (gitignored), so the existing extraResources mapping (resources/jre -> jre) needs no change.

nodes.label: Cross-platform Build Matrix (mac/win/linux)
nodes.rationale: macos-14 builds --mac --arm64, windows-latest builds --win (NSIS), ubuntu-latest builds --linux (AppImage); fail-fast disabled so one platform failing does not kill the others.

nodes.label: Bundled JRE via jlink
nodes.rationale: minima.jar is Java 8 bytecode, so any modern JRE runs it. Temurin 21 LTS is available on all three runners; a minimal JRE is jlinked from it (java.se + jdk.unsupported, stripped/compressed) into resources/jre so end users need no system Java.
